title: Nobody is coming

scenes.say: Nobody is coming to save you.
scenes.visual: a man standing alone in an empty parking lot at night under one light

scenes.say: That sounds cold, but it is freedom.
scenes.visual: an open road stretching to the horizon at first light

scenes.say: It means nobody else holds the key.
scenes.visual: close up of a single key resting in an open palm

scenes.say: You do not need permission to start over.
scenes.visual: a blank notebook and a pen on a kitchen table, morning light

scenes.say: You need one decision and one day of work.
scenes.visual: a man writing in a notebook at a small desk, lamp light, focused
a wall calendar with days crossed off in marker, close up

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a man walking down an open road toward the sunrise, seen from behind

caption: Nobody is coming. That means the key is in your hand.
